questions.question: Why does the psalmist say he loves the LORD in Psalm 116?
options: Because the LORD subdued all of the nations before him
Because the LORD heard his voice and pleas for mercy
Because the LORD revealed his law and statutes
Because the LORD gave him wealth and honor
questions.answer: Because the LORD heard his voice and pleas for mercy

questions.question: What does the psalmist ask, having received so much?
options: Who is able to stand before so great and so holy a God?
What shall I render to the LORD for all his benefits to me?
Where can I possibly flee away from the presence of the LORD?
How long, O LORD, will you go on forgetting me forever?
questions.answer: What shall I render to the LORD for all his benefits to me?

questions.question: The psalmist says precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
I love the LORD, because he has heard my voice and my pleas for _____.
I will lift up the cup of _____ and call on the name of the LORD.
